mapper.sql: id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, last_error, processing_started_at, next_retry_at, created_at, published_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events ( aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status ) VALUES ( #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL, processing_started_at = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, processing_started_at = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, processing_started_at = NULL, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM outbox_events WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW())) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_started_at <= #{processingTimeoutAt}) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_started_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ( (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW())) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_started_at <= #{processingTimeoutAt}) )
